decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel underpins the firm's direction toward binding mobile communication and one secure identity across channels, so results are likely near aspiration and there is little reason to search for other uses of its resources.

Mobile PDF signing supports the strategic goal of online contract signing and costs little to maintain, though its absence from the website in 2020 and 2021 suggests it may be folded into broader offerings.
The multi-layer end-to-end architecture frames the integrated portfolio, so dropping it would release few resources and could weaken the firm's overall security proposition.

The email-to-app robot is a niche add-on with uncertain results and no visible market presence since 2019, so as the firm shifts toward platform ecosystems, problemistic search favours moving its resources into core development.
The market is moving to app-based authentication, which likely keeps the QR hardware token below aspiration, and slack is better spent on mobile identity platforms than on a hardware niche.

The payment compliance suite is peripheral to the core identity offer, but it serves the regulated customers central to the firm's value proposition, so slack allows it to be carried for another year.
